svg.text: The joined table: two worlds, one structure
Chadverse core (7 group posts) + Bronzina's Coset (first 16 TB × sandrabronzina co-posts). Rows = accounts.
TB: in both worlds, the cut vertex; not m
m: the owner whose posts hold the regulars
R1, R2, … = shared rooms (identical rows); unmarked = room of one
m in each world is the owner of the posts the regulars sit on, in the same gold:
Chadverse core: latterdayavenger (owns all 7). Bronzina's Coset: expofamily.cl (owns #11–#15).
Not TB. He is the one account in both worlds, the cut vertex where they touch: most central, not m.
Proved: at most one monkey per object, m; every account other than m is a robot.
Robot = any account other than m: a role in the structure, not a statement about who or what runs an account.
Data and checkers: github.com/AntMerrill/backfire-tracking, docs/data (holland24, who-went-first, tb-collabs, for-agents).
